What is Get High And Fly?

GHAF is an annual big air kitesurfing competition. Riders from across the region gather to push limits, fly higher, and compete in the most spectacular discipline in kitesurfing.

Whether you're a seasoned pro or an ambitious amateur — there's a place for you here. The competition runs across four categories, with qualified judging and full safety setup.

The Spot

Malibu Beach in Mui Ne is one of Southeast Asia's premier wind corridors — a flat-water bay backed by red sand dunes, delivering consistent NE trade winds from November through April. The natural geography creates a steady 18–28 knot window with sideshore direction, ideal for big air. Setup includes a deep-water launch zone, safety boat cover, and a panoramic beachfront for spectators. The Kitenam school has been running this spot for over a decade. Main website: vietnam-kitesurfing.com

Wind conditions

Peak season: January–February. Wind direction: NE–E thermal, consistent sideshore. Average: 18–28 knots, gusts to 35. Water temp: 24–27°C. Air temp: 25–32°C. Blue skies, low rain probability.
